Classification: NOT SUBSYSTEM CAPACITY. Reviewer log-odds coefficient -0.244 CI [-0.389, -0.118] q=0.003. Holdout 2024-2026 coefficient -0.322, same sign=True.

  Entropy slope 0.148 bits/year CI [0.073, 0.241] q=0.006. Entropy rises, so newcomer pull requests spread across more subsystems over time.
  Pearson r, reviewers and silence, -0.102 n=80 CI [-0.265, 0.097] q=0.520.
  Cohen's d, silence in high-reviewer versus low-reviewer cells: -0.030 negligible effect size regardless of p-value.
  The silence equation is newcomer silence ~ year + subsystem active reviewers + log lines + files + author tenure. Year enters as a linear term. Year dummies would absorb the slope this gap is testing. Pre-2016 reviewer counts are missing, so the regression sample is the review-object era inside 2010-2023.

WHAT THIS CLOSES
  Gap 1, per-year principle scores against later health: the timeseries, the largest single-year decline of each scored principle, and the lagged correlations. P5 and P7 stay unscored. The correlations are low power and are not a causal lead.
  Gap 2, whether the six confirmed effects are specific to poorly governed repositories: not closed. Every comparison repository with seven or more years lacks review objects, participant identities, and a meeting list. The Spearman row is DATA UNAVAILABLE. The bitcoin/bitcoin row is the pass-3 estimate.
  Gap 3, whether patch-content false negatives are a standing filter or a post-2018 drift: classified STRUCTURAL from the entry-year distribution and the year slope.
  Gap 4, whether the rise in newcomer silence is subsystem reviewer capacity: classified NOT SUBSYSTEM CAPACITY from the reviewer coefficient and the change in the year slope.

WHAT THIS CANNOT PROVE
  (1) Lagged correlations in a 16-year series are low power and cannot establish causation.
  (2) Cross-repo effect comparisons assume comparable data quality across repositories, which may not hold.
  (3) Subsystem mapping from file paths is an approximation and PRs touching multiple subsystems are assigned by plurality.
  (4) The false-negative timeline cannot distinguish whether the filter worsened because standards rose or because social routing became more load-bearing over time.
